operational_notes: Read repository instructions and the existing US24 manual guide, checked the branch and working tree, and preserved existing changes.
Made the two preliminary curl health probes recorded below. A restricted process-list read did not identify the listener; successful HTTP responses established reachability.
An attempted Node recording-client connection failed under its restricted networking environment, without an HTTP response. Continued using a permission-enabled local HTTP client.

Used an interactive, phased HTTP API-client walkthrough. A small helper recorded requests and responses and compared the stated expectations. This is API-level verification, not a browser/Postman GUI recording and not a rerun of Go unit tests.

Registered three labeled test accounts, logged in as each role, and created all fixtures through the same public HTTP routes available to an API client. No direct database writes, migrations, mock repositories, or alternate API server were used.

After step 49, the local recording helper failed while formatting numeric offer IDs in a state-check summary. All HTTP requests/responses were already saved successfully. The helper was corrected and the saved step 49 response was reviewed without replaying any mutation. This was a recording-tool issue, not an API failure.
Reviewed the saved responses and persisted-state reads after each phase. Two concurrency probes used two actual HTTP requests sent together with separate client threads.
Made final health and readiness reads. Left the user-running backend and its configuration unchanged and retained the labeled test records for inspection.
Exported the sanitized report and transcript, checked that neither contains any generated password or bearer token, and removed the temporary credential-state file after export.
